review.tagline: Tensor and neural network framework with Python and C++ APIs
review.summary: TensorFlow is a machine learning framework for building, training and deploying models, with stable Python and C++ APIs and non-guaranteed APIs for other languages. It installs via pip, with CUDA GPU support on Ubuntu and Windows and a smaller CPU-only package. Related tooling includes TensorBoard and LiteRT for Android.
review.audience: ML engineers and researchers building and deploying neural networks
strengths: CUDA GPU support via pip on Ubuntu and Windows; separate tensorflow-cpu package
Device plugins for DirectX and macOS Metal
Surrounding tooling: TensorBoard, LiteRT for Android, official models and tutorials
weaknesses: APIs for languages other than Python and C++ have no backward compatibility guarantee
Built-in GPU support is CUDA only; other devices need separate plugins
Linux XLA build artifacts listed as TBA
RAM and VRAM requirements not stated in the README
